-- Permanent, additive bonuses keep repeat runs faster without exponential runaway.
local R = {}
R.MaxRebirths = 50
R.SnowPerRebirth = 0.50
R.LuckPerRebirth = 0.25
R.Milestones = {
 {Stage = "Cursed", Cost = 500000},
 {Stage = "Crystal", Cost = 25000000},
 {Stage = "Retro", Cost = 1000000000},
 {Stage = "Jungle", Cost = 25000000000},
 {Stage = "AbsoluteZero", Cost = 350000000000},
 {Stage = "Portal", Cost = 4000000000000},
}
function R.Count(value)
 if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then return 0 end
 return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, R.MaxRebirths)
end
function R.Multipliers(count)
 count = R.Count(count)
 return 1 + count * R.SnowPerRebirth, 1 + count * R.LuckPerRebirth
end
function R.Requirement(count)
 count = R.Count(count)
 if count >= R.MaxRebirths then return nil end
 local level = count + 1
 local tier = R.Milestones[math.min(level, #R.Milestones)]
 local repeats = math.max(1, level - #R.Milestones + 1)
 return {Level = level, Stage = tier.Stage, Cost = tier.Cost * repeats * repeats}
end
return R

-- Pure server-side transaction rules; no yields occur between validation and reset.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local R = require(RS:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local Shovels = require(RS:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local Pets = require(RS:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local Stages = require(RS:WaitForChild("StageConfig"))
local Upgrades = require(RS:WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))
local Rules = {}

function Rules.Check(d, expected)
 if not d then return false, "Your progress is still loading." end
 if type(expected) ~= "number" or expected ~= R.Count(d.Rebirths) then
  return false, "Your rebirth changed. Check the rewards and try again."
 end
 local req = R.Requirement(d.Rebirths)
 if not req then return false, "You reached the maximum rebirth level!" end
 if not d.Stages or d.Stages[req.Stage] ~= true then
  return false, "Unlock " .. Stages.ById[req.Stage].Name .. " first."
 end
 if type(d.Snow) ~= "number" or d.Snow ~= d.Snow or d.Snow == math.huge or d.Snow < req.Cost then
  return false, "You need more Snow to rebirth."
 end
 return true, req
end

local function equippedAfterReset(list, owned, byName, slots, score)
 local clean, used = {}, {}
 for _, name in ipairs(list or {}) do
  if byName[name] and (used[name] or 0) < (owned[name] or 0) then
   used[name] = (used[name] or 0) + 1
   table.insert(clean, name)
  end
 end
 table.sort(clean, function(a, b) return score(byName[a]) > score(byName[b]) end)
 while #clean > slots do table.remove(clean) end
 return clean
end

function Rules.Apply(d, expected)
 local ok, req = Rules.Check(d, expected)
 if not ok then return false, req end
 -- Compute the new equipped sets before changing the profile.
 local equipped = equippedAfterReset(d.Equipped, d.Counts, Shovels.ByName, Upgrades.Base.ShovelSlots, function(x) return x.Chance end)
 local pets = equippedAfterReset(d.EquippedPets, d.Pets, Pets.PetByName, Upgrades.Base.PetSlots, function(x) return x.Boost end)
 d.Rebirths = req.Level
 d.Snow = 0
 d.Stages = {}
 d.Upgrades = {}
 d.Equipped = equipped
 d.EquippedPets = pets
 -- Counts, Pets, PetIndex, Settings, TotalRolls and base luck are preserved.
 return true, req
end
return Rules

local U = require(RS:WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))

local refreshed = RS:WaitForChild("DataRefresh")
local cooldown = {}

local function publish(player, d)
 local snow, luck = R.Multipliers(d.Rebirths)
 player:SetAttribute("Rebirths", R.Count(d.Rebirths))
 player:SetAttribute("RebirthSnowMult", snow)
 player:SetAttribute("RebirthLuckMult", luck)
 D.SetStat(player, "Rebirths", R.Count(d.Rebirths))
end
D.OnLoaded(publish)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) cooldown[p] = nil end)

request.OnServerInvoke = function(player, expected)
 local now = os.clock()
 if cooldown[player] and now - cooldown[player] < 1 then return false, "Please wait a moment." end
 cooldown[player] = now
 local d = D.Get(player)
 local char = player.Character
 local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false, "Wait until your character has respawned." end
 local spawn = workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
 if not spawn then return false, "The spawn point is unavailable. Please try again." end
 local ok, result = Rules.Apply(d, expected)
 if not ok then return false, result end

 -- Reset replicated gameplay state immediately, before any further collection ticks.
 local stats = U.Calculate(d.Upgrades, player:GetAttribute("FriendsHere") or 0)
 local snow, luck = R.Multipliers(d.Rebirths)
 stats.SnowMult *= snow
 stats.LuckMult *= luck
 for k, v in pairs(stats) do player:SetAttribute(k, v) end
 for id in pairs(U.ById) do player:SetAttribute("Up_" .. id, false) end
 for _, s in ipairs(StageConfig.Order) do player:SetAttribute("Stage_" .. s.Id, s.Id == "Starter") end
 player:SetAttribute("EquippedShovels", table.concat(d.Equipped, ","))
 player:SetAttribute("EquippedPets", table.concat(d.EquippedPets, ","))
 hum.WalkSpeed = stats.WalkSpeed
 D.SetStat(player, "Snow", 0)
 publish(player, d)
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
 char:PivotTo(spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, spawn.Size.Y / 2 + 4, 0))
 SS.AdminHooks.ReapplyUpgrades:Fire(player)
 SS.AdminHooks.ReapplyStages:Fire(player)
 refreshed:FireClient(player)
 task.spawn(D.Save, player)
 return true, "Rebirth complete! Your permanent bonuses are active."
end

-- DataService: one place that loads/saves each player's data.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local RebirthConfig = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local DataService = {}
local data = {}
local loaded = Instance.new("BindableEvent")

-- Studio-only clean balance sessions neither load nor save real progress.
-- Set ServerStorage's BalanceTestMode attribute before pressing Play to opt in.
local testMode = game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() and game:GetService("ServerStorage"):GetAttribute("BalanceTestMode") == true
local store
if not testMode then pcall(function() store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("RNGData_v1") end) end

local function defaults(d)
	d.Rebirths = RebirthConfig.Count(d.Rebirths)
	d.Counts = type(d.Counts) == "table" and d.Counts or {}
	d.TotalRolls = tonumber(d.TotalRolls) or 0
	d.Snow = tonumber(d.Snow) or 0
	d.Stages = type(d.Stages) == "table" and d.Stages or {}
	d.Upgrades = type(d.Upgrades) == "table" and d.Upgrades or {}
	d.Settings = type(d.Settings) == "table" and d.Settings or {}
	d.Luck = tonumber(d.Luck) or 1 -- roll luck multiplier (luck upgrades raise this)
	if type(d.Equipped) == "string" then d.Equipped = {d.Equipped} end
	if type(d.Equipped) ~= "table" then d.Equipped = {} end
	d.Pets = type(d.Pets) == "table" and d.Pets or {}
	d.EquippedPets = type(d.EquippedPets) == "table" and d.EquippedPets or {}
	d.PetIndex = type(d.PetIndex) == "table" and d.PetIndex or {}
	for name, n in pairs(d.Pets) do if n > 0 then d.PetIndex[name] = true end end
	return d
end

local function stat(ls, name, value)
	local v = Instance.new("IntValue")
	v.Name = name
	v.Value = value
	v.Parent = ls
end

local function load(player)
	if data[player] then return end
	local saved
	if store then
		local ok, res = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("u" .. player.UserId) end)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" then saved = res end
	end
	if not player.Parent then return end
	local d = defaults(saved or {})
	data[player] = d
	player:SetAttribute("BalanceTestSession", testMode)

	local ls = Instance.new("Folder")
	ls.Name = "leaderstats"
	stat(ls, "Snow", d.Snow)
	stat(ls, "Rolls", d.TotalRolls)
	stat(ls, "Rebirths", d.Rebirths)
	ls.Parent = player

	loaded:Fire(player, d)
end

-- Serialize autosave, rebirth, and leave saves so an older write cannot finish last.
local saving, saveAgain = {}, {}
local function save(player)
 if not store or not data[player] then return end
 if saving[player] then
  saveAgain[player] = true
  repeat task.wait() until not saving[player]
  return
 end
 saving[player] = true
 repeat
  saveAgain[player] = nil
  local snapshot = game.HttpService:JSONDecode(game.HttpService:JSONEncode(data[player]))
  local ok, err
  for attempt = 1, 3 do
   ok, err = pcall(function() store:SetAsync("u" .. player.UserId, snapshot) end)
   if ok then break end
   if attempt < 3 then task.wait(attempt) end
  end
  if not ok then warn("[DataService] Save failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
 until not saveAgain[player]
 saving[player] = nil
end
function DataService.Save(player) save(player) end

function DataService.Get(player)
	return data[player]
end

-- run callback for every player whose data is loaded (now and in the future)
function DataService.OnLoaded(callback)
	for p, d in pairs(data) do task.spawn(callback, p, d) end
	return loaded.Event:Connect(callback)
end

function DataService.SetStat(player, name, value)
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local v = ls and ls:FindFirstChild(name)
	if v then v.Value = value end
end

function DataService.AddSnow(player, amount)
	local d = data[player]
	if not d then return end
	d.Snow += amount
	DataService.SetStat(player, "Snow", d.Snow)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(load)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(load, p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	save(player)
	data[player] = nil
end)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do save(p) end
end)
task.spawn(function() -- autosave
	while true do
		task.wait(120)
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(save, p) end
	end
end)

return DataService

-- UpgradeService: buys hex tiles and turns owned tiles into stats (player attributes) that the other systems read.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local U = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))
local RebirthConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local buy = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyUpgrade")

local friendCount = {}
local lastBuy = {}

local function owned(d)
	local set = {}
	for id, v in pairs(d.Upgrades) do if v and U.ById[id] then set[id] = true end end
	return set
end

local function apply(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return end
	local set = owned(d)
	local stats = U.Calculate(set, friendCount[player] or 0)
 local snow, luck = RebirthConfig.Multipliers(d.Rebirths)
 stats.SnowMult *= snow
 stats.LuckMult *= luck
 player:SetAttribute("Rebirths", RebirthConfig.Count(d.Rebirths))
 player:SetAttribute("RebirthSnowMult", snow)
 player:SetAttribute("RebirthLuckMult", luck)
 DataService.SetStat(player, "Rebirths", RebirthConfig.Count(d.Rebirths))
	for k, v in pairs(stats) do player:SetAttribute(k, v) end
	player:SetAttribute("FriendsHere", friendCount[player] or 0)
	for id in pairs(U.ById) do player:SetAttribute("Up_" .. id, set[id] == true) end
	local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = stats.WalkSpeed end
end

local function recountFriends()
	local list = Players:GetPlayers()
	for _, p in ipairs(list) do
		task.spawn(function()
			local n = 0
			for _, other in ipairs(list) do
				if other ~= p then
					local ok, isFriend = pcall(function() return p:IsFriendsWith(other.UserId) end)
					if ok and isFriend then n += 1 end
				end
			end
			friendCount[p] = n
			apply(p)
		end)
	end
end

DataService.OnLoaded(function(player)
	apply(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.defer(apply, player) end)
	recountFriends()
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	friendCount[p] = nil
	lastBuy[p] = nil
	task.defer(recountFriends)
end)

buy.OnServerInvoke = function(player, id)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	local n = type(id) == "string" and U.ById[id]
	if not d or not n then return false, "Unknown" end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastBuy[player] and now - lastBuy[player] < 0.15 then return false, "Slow down" end
	lastBuy[player] = now
	local set = owned(d)
	if set[id] then return false, "Owned" end
	local reason = U.LockReason(n, set, d.Stages)
	if reason then return false, reason end
	local cost = U.CostOf(n)
	if d.Snow < cost then return false, "Not enough snow" end
	DataService.AddSnow(player, -cost)
	d.Upgrades[id] = true
	apply(player)
	return true
end

local function showToast(text, color)
	toast.Text = text
	toast.TextColor3 = color
	toast.TextTransparency = 0

-- visual filler items: common ones appear more often, like the real odds
local weightTotal = 0
for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do weightTotal += 1 / it.Chance end
local function randomItem()
	local n = math.random() * weightTotal
	for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		n -= 1 / it.Chance
		if n <= 0 then return it end
	end
	return Config.Items[1]
end
local function itemAt(j)
	if not seq[j] then seq[j] = randomItem() end
	return seq[j]
end

local function setItem(s, item)
	s.item = item
	s.odds.Text = "1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance)
	s.name.Text = string.upper(item.Name)
	s.holder:ClearAllChildren()
	ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = s.holder
end

local posValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
posValue.Value = 0
local lastPos, speed = 0, 0

local function render()
	local pos = posValue.Value
	local base = math.floor(pos + 0.5)
	local range = mode.range
	local used = {}
	local motion = math.clamp(speed / 35, 0, 1)
	for j = base - range, base + range do
		local s = slots[(j % NSLOTS) + 1]
		used[s] = true
		local item = itemAt(j)
		if s.item ~= item then setItem(s, item) end
		local d = j - pos
		local ad = math.abs(d)
		s.cg.Visible = true
		s.cg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot)
		s.cg.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5 + d * mode.slot)
		-- fade + darken with distance, extra transparency when moving fast (motion blur feel)
		local fade = math.clamp(ad / (range + 0.5), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupTransparency = math.clamp(fade * 0.92 + motion * (ad < 0.5 and 0.25 or 0.45), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(FADED, math.clamp(ad * 1.2, 0, 1))
		s.scale.Scale = (1 - math.min(ad, 2) * 0.17) * s.pop
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(slots) do
		if not used[s] then s.cg.Visible = false end
	end
end

	local p = posValue.Value

	lastPos = p
	rays.Rotation = (rays.Rotation + dt * 20) % 360
	if stage.Visible then render() end
end)

	tween(camera, 0.35, {FieldOfView = base}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()

local function doRoll()
	if rolling or gui:GetAttribute("RebirthMenuOpen") then return end
	rolling = true
	rollId += 1
	local myId = rollId

	local animScale = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RollAnimScale") or 1
	local gap = (Config.RollCooldown * animScale + 0.1) - (os.clock() - lastFire)
	if gap > 0 then task.wait(gap) end

	local result, counts, equipped, luck
	waiting = function(r, c, e, l) result, counts, equipped, luck = r, c, e, l end
	lastFire = os.clock()
	remote:FireServer()

	showStage()
	tween(rays, 0.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.55})
	tween(glowScale, 0.2, {Scale = 1})

	-- creep the reel while the server answers
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while result == nil and os.clock() - t0 < 3 do
		posValue.Value += 0.15
		task.wait()
	end
	waiting = nil
	if not result then
		rolling = false
		hideStage()
		return
	end

	local fast = gui:GetAttribute("FastRolls")
	local base = math.floor(posValue.Value + 0.5)
	local dist = fast and 8 or (26 + math.random(0, 6))
	local target = base + dist
	for j = base + 1, target + 4 do seq[j] = randomItem() end
	seq[target] = Config.ByName[result] or Config.Items[1]
	for j in pairs(seq) do
		if j < base - 10 then seq[j] = nil end -- keep memory tiny
	end

	-- decelerate, overshoot a touch, settle back onto the winner
	local wonItem = Config.ByName[result]
	if Cutscene.ShouldPlay(wonItem, luck) then
		-- RARE: reel starts, then the screen cuts to black for the cutscene
		local tw = tween(posValue, 3.1, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		task.wait(0.9)
		Cutscene.Play(wonItem, luck)
		tw:Cancel()
		posValue.Value = target
	else
		tween(posValue, fast and 0.7 or 3.1 * animScale, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint).Completed:Wait()
		tween(posValue, 0.35, {Value = target}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
	end

	-- winner!
	local win = slots[(target % NSLOTS) + 1]
	local popV = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	popV.Value = 1.3
	popV.Changed:Connect(function(v) win.pop = v end)
	win.pop = 1.3
	tween(popV, 0.4, {Value = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Connect(function() popV:Destroy(); win.pop = 1 end)
	glowScale.Scale = 1.5
	tween(glowScale, 0.5, {Scale = 1.2}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	rays.GroupTransparency = 0
	tween(rays, 1.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.3})
	if (Config.ByName[result] and Config.ByName[result].Chance or 0) >= Config.BigRollAt then
		task.spawn(fovPunch)
	end

	rollFinished:Fire(result, counts, equipped)
	rolling = false

	task.delay(1.8, function()
		if rollId == myId and not rolling then hideStage() end
	end)
end

local SUFFIX = {k = 1e3, m = 1e6, b = 1e9, t = 1e12, qa = 1e15, qi = 1e18}
local function amount(s)
	if not s then return nil end
	s = s:lower():gsub(",", "")
	local num, suf = s:match("^(%-?[%d%.]+)(%a*)$")
	num = tonumber(num)
	if not num then return nil end
	if suf ~= "" then
		if not SUFFIX[suf] then return nil end
		num *= SUFFIX[suf]
	end
	return num
end

local function targets(caller, s)
	if not s or s == "" or s:lower() == "me" then return {caller} end
	if s:lower() == "all" then return Players:GetPlayers() end
	local q = s:lower()
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p.Name:lower():sub(1, #q) == q or p.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #q) == q then return {p} end
	end
	return {}
end

-- finds by exact name, then "starts with", then "contains"; "void" finds "Void Shovel"
local function find(list, q)
	q = (q or ""):lower()
	if q == "" then return nil end
	for _, it in ipairs(list) do if it.Name:lower() == q then return it end end
	for _, it in ipairs(list) do if it.Name:lower():sub(1, #q) == q then return it end end
	for _, it in ipairs(list) do if it.Name:lower():find(q, 1, true) then return it end end
	return nil
end

local function run(player, msg)
	if type(msg) ~= "string" or msg:sub(1, #PREFIX) ~= PREFIX then return end
	if not isAdmin(player) then return end
	local args = {}
	for w in msg:sub(#PREFIX + 1):gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(args, w) end
	local name = table.remove(args, 1)
	local cmd = name and COMMANDS[name:lower()]
	if not cmd then
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, "Unknown command. Type " .. PREFIX .. "help", false)
		return
	end
	local ok, result, err = pcall(cmd.fn, player, args)
	if not ok then
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, "Error: " .. tostring(result), false)
	elseif result then
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, result, true)
	else
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, err or "Failed", false)
	end
end

cmdEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(run)
